The boat in the background has a slightly warped geometry and lacks sharp definition, blending somewhat unnaturally with the horizon/water line.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: The provided diagnostic checkpoints are completely mismatched (describing a filing cabinet). Ignore them entirely. Focus heavily on the 'mechanical coherence' of the deck equipment. AI often generates 'greebled' details that look like machinery from a distance but fall apart under scrutiny (fused pipes, non-functional nozzles). Also, scrutinize the water spray; it should look like high-pressure fluid, not solid white ribbons or smoke.
